card.name: Start of a new drug or term
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a name or term after a list-like lead-in, such as 'in combination with', a comma in a drug list, or an opening bracket. Often a lone 'T' or 't' that begins a drug name like tildrakizumab, tadalafil or tocainide.

modes.label: Drug name starts
modes.description: A single letter 't' or 'T' that opens a drug name inside a list or phrase.

modes.description: A short linking word after 'combination' or an opening bracket that introduces a drug class.
